title: Bob the Canadian: on the road

lines.text: Welcome to this video about roads, streets, and highways.
This road here is a paved road, that means the surface of the road is hard,
cars can go a lot faster and it's just easier to drive on.
And this part right here is called the shoulder of the road.
When you pull off the road, you can go on to the shoulder of the road.
This part over here, it's kind of a little hard to see, is called the ditch.
And the ditch is where, when it rains, all the water would run off the road,
into the ditch to keep the road nice and dry.
The road behind me is what we would call a gravel road or a dirt road.
A paved road, like we saw, has a hard surface.
A gravel road has all of these little stones.
I'll hold them up to the camera.
Behind me, you'll see a stop sign.
This is a red sign with the word stop in it.
And it has eight sides. It's an octagon.
